question: Hello, Oda-sensei. In chapter 858, there's another Nami bathing scene, but it'll be really awkward when it comes on the anime while the family is watching. What should I do when that time comes? -
answer: This corner is indecent!! Strange... is this ok? Please listen well. Mankind used to go around naked a long time ago. For the sight of a bathing scene to make your heart go crazy, doesn't that just indicate that you do not have enough discipline? P.S. While I was drawing the manuscript, my heart started pounding and I got a nosebleed.
name: Sanadacchi
